== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
The earlier slip limits the action to once per turn. The later slip uses the just-won battle at Dannik’s location as the response condition. The player still uses 1 Force to put one card from the opponent’s Lost Pile out of play. Both slips print the same character values.
